---

sddviz exists to put a project's recorded reasoning in front of the people who are not at a terminal. An SDD graph is read through an agent today, which serves a developer at a keyboard well and serves project leads, strategists, project owners and UI/UX experts poorly: reaching the reasoning costs a terminal, an agent session, and fluency in the tool's vocabulary.

The pull is that any of those people opens the graph and follows what was decided and why, on their own, with no terminal and no agent session.

There is no completion criterion. Every later decision about what the viewer shows, how it is navigated, and what vocabulary it puts on screen is weighed against whether it serves a reader who does not write code.
